atoms.a: ssml: Hello Pirate! Do you know left from right?<break time="500ms"/> Oh, really? <break time="500ms"/> Find the palm tree that is on the left of the picture.
And now find the palm tree on the right!
atoms.finishSound: I see! You’re really good at this, aren’t you? Let us go on an adventure searching for treasure.

atoms.a: ssml: The search for treasure can begin! <break time='500ms'/> I have an idea: <break time='200ms'/> I’ll read the treasure map and you choose the direction we need to go in.<break time='300ms'/> <break time='500ms'/> Right then, first we have to go to the tree on the left. Find the correct tree.
ssml: Now we have to go to the palm trees that are on the right. Find the palm trees on the right.
ssml: Now we must go to the waterfall in the middle. Find the correct waterfall.
ssml: Oh no, it’s already getting dark. Quickly, we have to go to the castle on the right. Select the correct castle.
ssml: There is more than one treasure chest! But which one is the right one? The map says the correct treasure chest is on the left, under the two swords.

atoms.sound: You did it! Thanks for helping me find the treasure chest.
